statement: For C_18(z)=z^19(12654z^36-684z^18-306)/(2(19z^18-1)^3), every connected component of the Fatou set is contained in the attracting basin of one of the roots in {0} union {z:z^18=1}.
contribution: An exact second-iterate certificate captures all free critical points in the full basin of 0; a complete critical-orbit classification and the standard classification of rational periodic Fatou components then exclude every non-root Fatou component.
